monster.name: Belial (Prince of the Covetous, Lord of Lusts)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Belial makes one Fork of Suffering attack and two Corrupting Touch attacks.

action.name: Fork of Suffering
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}25 ({@damage 4d8 + 7}) piercing damage and the target must succeed a {@dc 21} constitution saving throw or suffer an addition {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage at the start of each of its turns. The target creature may attempt the save after suffering the additional damage, ending the effect with a successful save. The effect ends if the target creature is the recipient of healing magic.

action.name: Corrupting Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) psychic damage and the target must succeed on a {@dc 24} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition charmed} by Belial for one minute.

Belial is a 10-foot-tall handsome humanoid with chalky skin and reddish-brown hair and beard. Rams horns curling from his wide brow flicker with hellfire. Charred wings sprout from the fiend's back, revealing the last vestiges of his once angelic form.

Belial is the most capricious and chaotic of the princes of darkness, leaving many among the courts of Hell to wonder if he has not been fully corrupted by demonic influences. Belial, more than others has made pacts with demons, and dark gods of the Underworld. He is always on the hunt for portals that allow him greater time and access to the mortal realms.

Belial's lair is found in the storm-thundered Hell Ring of Covetous where the lightning-wracked skies flock with harpies, night hags, succubi, and erinyes. Belial's legions throng with his many progeny, themselves brutal combatants who use complex asymmetrical tactics to finish off foes who often greatly outnumber them.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that are not silver

trait.name: Charming Devil
entries: Belial has a way with words, which he infuses with his own Hellish pheromones. At the start of his turn, Belial chooses one of the following effects: Indecent Proposal. All who can hear Belial and are within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw or suffer the effects of the spell {@spell suggestion}.

trait.name: Maleficent Mesmerism
entries: Belial suggestive charms and animal magnetism leave his listeners enrapt in his words so that they are unable to move save to gape at his animal magnetism. All who can see Belial and are within 30 feet must succeed on a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition incapacitated} until the end of their next turn.

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the devil's darkvision

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Belial fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Belial has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: Belial's weapon attacks are magical.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Belial regains 10 hit points at the start of his turn. If Belial takes damage from a silvered weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of Belial's next turn. Belial is destroyed only if he starts his turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: Belial's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 24}, +16 to hit with spell attacks). He can cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

legendary.name: Spear Thrust
entries: Belial makes a Fork of Suffering attack.

legendary.name: Hordes of Admirers
entries: Belial summons {@dice 2d6} commoners he has corrupted on the mortal planes and brings them to his palace for his own amusement, causing them to appear within 30 feet of Belial. They are useless in battle but provide a convenient distraction and slow attackers.

legendary.name: Wing Buffet (cost 2 actions)
entries: Belial buffets the air with his wings to create a 20-foot cone of powerful wind. All creatures caught in this area must succeed at a {@dc 25} Strength check or be knocked {@condition prone} and pushed 15 feet away from Belial.

legendary.name: Fiendish Recovery (costs 2 actions)
entries: Belial recovers 50 hit points and ends one condition affecting him.

monster.name: Chimeric Abomination
languages: understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but can't speak

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the abomination moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 38 ({@damage 7d10}) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Labyrinthine Recall
entries: The abomination can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The abomination has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The abomination deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The abomination makes three attacks: two with its fists and one with its fanged hoof. Alternatively, it replaces its fist attacks with one Chimeric Lash attack.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}45 ({@damage 7d10 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Fanged Hoof
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition prone} target. {@h}29 ({@damage 5d8 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Chimeric Lash
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., up to three targets within 5 feet of each other. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) psychic damage, and a target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet toward the abomination.

reaction.name: Synaptic Retaliation
entries: When a creature within 60 feet of the abomination hits it with an attack that deals psychic damage or attempts to target it with a spell that requires an Intelligence saving throw, the abomination flashes a burst of psychic feedback. The triggering creature must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage and have disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the brain fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The brain has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Primal Surge
entries: Due to its beast sacrifices, the brain's physical attacks deal magical damage and ignore resistances to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The brain makes three attacks: one with its Fanged Maw and two with its Chimeric Tentacles.

action.name: Fanged Maw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 5}) piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage.

action.name: Chimeric Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 19}).

action.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The brain magically emits psionic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence saving throw or take 45 ({@damage 10d8}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary.name: Tentacle Strike / Flail
entries: The brain makes one Chimeric Tentacle attack or attempts to slam a {@condition grappled} creature into the ground (dealing 16 bludgeoning damage and knocking them {@condition prone}).

legendary.name: Psionic Pulse (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The brain emits a wave of psychic pressure. Each creature within 30 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed 20 feet away from the pool and knocked {@condition prone}.

legendary.name: Primal Scream (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The brain unleashes a horrific, echoing roar directly into the minds of its enemies. Every creature within 60 feet must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of the brain for 1 minute.
The Chimeric Elder Brain dwells suspended over a massive vat of ceremorphosis brine, biologically warped with apex predator tissue.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Clarion is a 15th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 23}, {@hit 15} to hit with spell attacks). Clarion has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Aura of Heavenly Valor
entries: Friendly creatures within 30 feet of Clarion have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened}. Additionally, when a friendly creature in the aura deals damage with a weapon attack, it deals an extra 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage.

trait.name: Clarion's Radiance
entries: When Clarion takes damage from a creature within 60 feet of him, he can emit a flash of blinding light; the attacker must succeed on a {@dc 23} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Clarion fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Clarion can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}21 ({@damage 2d10 + 10}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d8 + 10}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Clarion's choice that is within 120 feet of him and aware of him must succeed on a {@dc 23} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Clarion's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: Clarion uses one of the following breath weapons:

items: {@b Celestial Cold Breath.} Clarion exhales a blast of silvery, celestial frost in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw, taking 58 ({@damage 13d8}) cold damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Evil creatures have disadvantage on this saving throw.

{@b Paralyzing Breath.} Clarion exhales paralyzing gas in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 24} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Ward of the Heavens (2/Day)
entries: Clarion touches a willing creature with his claw or snout. The target gains 30 temporary hit points, and for 1 minute, it gains a +2 bonus to AC and resistance to radiant and necrotic damage.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Clarion magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than his own, or back into his true form. He reverts to his true form if he dies. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Clarion's choice).

In a new form, Clarion retains his alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

reaction.name: Aegis of the Silver Dragon
entries: When a creature Clarion can see within 30 feet of him is targeted by an attack roll, Clarion can flash with blinding silver radiance, imposing disadvantage on the attack roll. If the attack misses, the attacker takes 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Clarion makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Clarion makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Silver Shield
entries: Clarion projects a protective barrier around an ally he can see within 60 feet. That ally gains a +3 bonus to AC until the start of Clarion's next turn.

legendary.name: Celestial Flash (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Clarion emits a blinding silver light. Each non-good creature within 30 feet of Clarion must succeed on a {@dc 23} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 3d4 + 7}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} until the end of Clarion's next turn.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Clarion beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of Clarion must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take 17 ({@damage 2d6 + 10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Clarion can then fly up to half his flying speed.
Clarion is a noble silver dragon who owes a favor to Queen Dagnabbet of Mithral Hall, occasionally aiding the Lords' Alliance when great threats arise.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Felgolos is a 14th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks). Felgolos has the following sorcerer spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Felgolos can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Felgolos fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Uncanny Luck
entries: Whenever Felgolos rolls a 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, he can reroll the die and must use the new roll. Additionally, when a creature hits Felgolos with a critical hit, roll a {@dice d6}. On a 5 or 6, the attack becomes a normal hit instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Felgolos can use his Frightful Presence. He then makes three attacks: one with his bite and two with his claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Felgolos's choice that is within 120 feet of him and aware of him must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Felgolos's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: Felgolos uses one of the following breath weapons:

items: {@b Lightning Breath.} Felgolos exhales lightning in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 ({@damage 12d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

{@b Repulsion Breath.} Felgolos exhales repulsion energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 19} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is pushed 60 feet away from Felgolos.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Felgolos magically polymorphs into a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating no higher than his own, or back into his true form. He reverts to his true form if he dies. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (Felgolos's choice).

In a new form, Felgolos retains his alignment, hit points, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, lair actions, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: Felgolos makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Felgolos makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Felgolos beats his wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Felgolos must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or take 14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Felgolos can then fly up to half his flying speed.

Felgolos, known as 'The Flying Misfortune', is an awkward and well-meaning adult bronze dragon known for his uncanny knack of blundering into trouble and his penchant for stealing wagons and cargo from the Zhentarim.

spellcasting.name: Paladin Spellcasting
headerEntries: Ghesh is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks, or {@hit 14} when using the {@item Talisman of Ultimate Evil}). He has the following paladin spells prepared:

trait.name: Aura of Hate & Courage
entries: Ghesh, along with allied fiends and undead within 30 feet of him, gains a +6 bonus to melee weapon damage rolls (included in attacks). Furthermore, Ghesh and friendly creatures within 30 feet can't be {@condition frightened}.

trait.name: Aura of Protection
entries: Whenever Ghesh or a friendly creature within 30 feet of him must make a saving throw, the creature gains a +6 bonus to the saving throw (already included in Ghesh's saves).

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Ghesh fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Ghesh has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects while wearing his {@item Mantle of Spell Resistance}.

trait.name: Tunnel Sentinel
entries: Ghesh can make opportunity attacks without expending his reaction. In addition, when a creature moves 5 feet or more while within his reach, he can use his reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.

trait.name: Undead Nature & Undying Soul (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Ghesh doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep. If reduced to 0 hit points, he can make a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw; on a success, he drops to 1 hit point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ghesh makes three melee attacks with The Chaos Star or the Giant Slayer Greataxe. He can replace one attack with his Black Dragon Breath.

action.name: The Chaos Star (+2 Lance)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}14 ({@damage 1d12 + 8}) piercing damage plus 6 necrotic damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage (from Improved Divine Smite). Ghesh rolls a {@dice d8} on a hit or critical smite for a chaos surge: 1 fire ({@damage 1d8}), 2 cold ({@damage 1d8}), 3 poison ({@damage 1d8}, or {@damage 5d6} ignoring resistance/immunity), 4 lightning ({@damage 1d8}), 5 acid ({@damage 1d8}), 6 force ({@damage 1d8}), 7 converts all damage to slashing (+{@damage 2d8}), 8 heals target for damage dealt instead.

action.name: Giant Slayer Greataxe
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 1d12 + 7}) slashing damage plus 6 necrotic damage and 4 ({@damage 1d8}) radiant damage. If the target is a giant, it takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) slashing damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Black Dragon Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: Ghesh exhales a stream of unholy acid in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

action.name: Dread Lord (1/Day)
entries: Ghesh surrounds himself with an aura of gloom that lasts for 1 minute. The aura reduces bright light within 30 feet to dim light. Any enemy that is {@condition frightened} of Ghesh and starts its turn in the aura takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) psychic damage. Ghesh and allies he chooses inside the aura are draped in deep shadows; creatures that rely on sight have disadvantage on attack rolls against them. While the aura lasts, Ghesh can use a bonus action to direct the shadows to strike one target with a melee spell attack ({@hit 12} to hit), dealing 16 ({@damage 3d10}) + 6 necrotic damage on a hit.

action.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil (6 Charges)
entries: Ghesh expends 1 charge targeting one good creature he can see on the ground within 120 feet. A flaming fissure opens beneath it; the target must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or fall in and be destroyed.

bonus.name: Lay on Hands (Pool: 100 HP)
entries: Ghesh touches an ally or himself, expending points to heal damage or cure poison/disease (5 HP per cure). As an undead lord, he can also use this pool to heal allied undead.

bonus.name: Chaos Recall
entries: Ghesh summons either The Chaos Star or his greataxe instantly to his hand from anywhere on the same plane of existence.

reaction.name: Chaos Warp (3 Charges, Recharges 1d3 at Dawn)
entries: When an attacker misses Ghesh or hits an ally, Ghesh expends 1 charge from The Chaos Star to teleport the attacker to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of him. There is a 50% chance Ghesh teleports adjacent to the attacker instead.

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke (5th-Level Spell)
entries: When damaged by a creature within 60 feet that he can see, Ghesh forces it to make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Chaos Skewer
entries: Ghesh makes one melee weapon attack.

legendary.name: Channel Divinity: Dreadful Aspect (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Each creature of Ghesh's choice within 30 feet that can see him must make a {@dc 20} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of him for 1 minute.

legendary.name: Shadow Step (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Ghesh teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied dim light or dark space he can see.

spellcasting.name: Dual-Class Spellcasting
headerEntries: Lee is a 20th-level dual spellcaster (Sorcerer/Warlock). His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 24}, {@hit 16} to hit with spell attacks; with Warlock spells via his {@item Rod of the Pact Keeper, +2||rod of the pact keeper +2}, spell save {@dc 26}, {@hit 18} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following spells prepared:

spellcasting.name: Mystic Arcanum
headerEntries: Lee can cast each of the following spells once per day without expending a spell slot:

trait.name: Lord of Phlegethos (Dual Mind)
entries: Lee can concentrate on up to two spells simultaneously. When he makes a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration, a single roll applies to both spells. In addition, allied fiends summoned by Lee gain temporary hit points equal to half his hit point maximum (139 hit points) upon appearing. While within 60 feet of Lee, these minions share his Magic Resistance trait and add +7 to their attack and damage rolls.

trait.name: Dark One's Blessing
entries: When Lee reduces a hostile creature to 0 hit points, he gains 23 temporary hit points.

trait.name: Dark One's Own Luck (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: When Lee makes an ability check or a saving throw, he can add a {@dice d10} to the roll. He can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur.

trait.name: Elemental Affinity & Hellfire Mastery
entries: When Lee casts a spell that deals fire damage, he adds +7 to one damage roll of that spell. Furthermore, fire damage dealt by Lee ignores fire resistance and treats fire immunity as fire resistance.

trait.name: Font of Magic (20 Sorcery Points)
entries: Lee has 20 sorcery points that he regains when he finishes a long rest. He regains 4 expended sorcery points whenever he finishes a short rest.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Lee fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: Lee has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Lee regains 20 hit points at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 hit point. If he takes cold or radiant damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Lee uses Infernal Command and makes four Eldritch Blast attacks, or he casts one spell and makes two Eldritch Blast attacks.

action.name: Eldritch Blast
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 18} to hit, range 300 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 1d10 + 7}) force damage, and the target is pushed up to 10 feet away from Lee in a straight line.

action.name: Fire Bolt
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 16} to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) fire damage.

action.name: Infernal Command
entries: Each fiendish ally of Lee's within 60 feet of him can't be {@condition charmed} or {@condition frightened} until the end of his next turn, and gains advantage on attack rolls until the start of Lee's next turn.

action.name: Summon Infernal Legion (1/Day)
entries: Lee rips open an infernal conduit to Phlegethos, conjuring an infernal horde in unoccupied spaces within 90 feet of him. He chooses one of the following groups:

items: 2d4 {@creature bearded devil||bearded devils} and 1d4 {@creature barbed devil||barbed devils}
1 {@creature bone devil} and 2d6 {@creature spined devil||spined devils}
1 {@creature horned devil} or 1 {@creature erinyes}

entries: Summoned fiends act immediately after Lee in the initiative order, obey his telepathic commands without requiring an action, and remain for 1 hour, until Lee dies, or until he dismisses them as a bonus action.

action.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil (6 Charges)
entries: Lee targets one creature he can see within 120 feet that is of a Good alignment. The target must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 35 ({@damage 10d6}) radiant damage and falls through a flaming fissure into the underworld, instantly destroyed if it is not a deity. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage.

bonus.name: Villainous Spell Surge
entries: When Lee casts a spell of 1st level or higher using his action, he can cast one cantrip or make two Eldritch Blast attacks as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Metamagic: Quickened Spell (Costs 2 Sorcery Points)
entries: When Lee casts a spell that has a casting time of 1 action, he changes the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

bonus.name: Metamagic: Subtle Spell (Costs 1 Sorcery Point)
entries: Lee casts a spell without somatic or verbal components.

bonus.name: Metamagic: Twinned Spell (Costs 1–9 Sorcery Points)
entries: When Lee casts a spell that targets only one creature and doesn't have a range of self, he targets a second creature in range with the same spell (costs sorcery points equal to the spell's level; 1 for a cantrip).

reaction.name: Hellish Rebuke (5th-Level Slot)
entries: When damaged by a creature within 60 feet that Lee can see, the attacker must make a {@dc 26} Dexterity saving throw, taking 33 ({@damage 6d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

reaction.name: Infernal Ring Leader
entries: When Lee is hit by an attack, he can choose one allied fiend within 10 feet of him. That ally is hit by the attack instead.

legendary.name: Eldritch Volley
entries: Lee makes two Eldritch Blast attacks.

legendary.name: Fiendish Stride
entries: Lee teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Command Legion
entries: Up to two allied fiends within 60 feet of Lee each use their reaction to move up to their speed or make one weapon attack.

legendary.name: Infernal Swarm (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Lee conjures 2 {@creature spined devil||spined devils} or 1 {@creature barbed devil} in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of him.

legendary.name: Cast Spell (Costs 1–3 Actions)
entries: Lee expends a spell slot to cast a spell of 1st, 2nd, or 3rd level. The action cost equals the level of the spell cast.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The mind flayer's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 15}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The mind flayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has surprised.

trait.name: Assassinate
entries: During its first turn, the mind flayer has advantage on attack rolls against any creature that hasn't taken a turn. Any hit the mind flayer scores against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mind flayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The mind flayer deals an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the mind flayer that isn't {@condition incapacitated} and the mind flayer doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) psychic damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 15}) and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until this grapple ends.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the mind flayer. {@h}55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the mind flayer kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

action.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The mind flayer magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Intelligence saving throw or take 22 ({@damage 4d8 + 4}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Renwick is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 21}, {@hit 13} to hit with spell attacks). Renwick has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Renwick fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Archlich Rejuvenation
entries: If Renwick is destroyed, he gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of Renwick's phylactery, safely secured within his warded planar sanctum.

trait.name: Planar Geometries & Conduit Mastery
entries: Renwick's spells and magical attacks ignore resistance to fire and force damage. In addition, Renwick has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Turn Immunity
entries: Renwick is immune to effects that turn undead.

action.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: {@atk ms} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition paralyzed} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Cinder Flare {@recharge 5}
entries: Renwick vents raw planar hellfire and infernal cinders from his conduits in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) fire damage and 21 ({@damage 6d6}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Renwick casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Spatial Shift
entries: Renwick magically teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, along with any equipment he is wearing or carrying.

legendary.name: Paralyzing Touch (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Renwick uses his Paralyzing Touch.

legendary.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Renwick fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet of him. The target must succeed on a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Renwick's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of Renwick must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Renwick Caradoon is an archmage and the brother of Samular Caradoon, founder of the Knights of Samular. Rather than succumb to battle wounds centuries ago, he drank an elixir of lichdom, and now resides within the Sacred Stone Monastery pursuing his solitary arcane studies.

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks while in dim light or darkness

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Tanazir is an 18th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 22}, {@hit 14} to hit with spell attacks). Tanazir requires no material components to cast his spells. Tanazir has following sorcerer spells prepared:

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Tanazir can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If Tanazir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Living Shadow
entries: While in dim light or darkness, Tanazir has resistance to damage that isn't force, psychic, or radiant.

trait.name: Chronal Shroud
entries: Tanazir's mastery over time warps incoming light and bends kinetic energy around his shifting form. Attack rolls made against Tanazir from a distance of more than 30 feet away have disadvantage.

trait.name: Chronal Clarity
entries: Tanazir has two turns each round. He takes his first turn at his full initiative count, and his second turn at his initiative count minus 10. He cannot use his reaction or a bonus action more than once per round, but his legendary actions refresh at the start of each of his turns.

trait.name: Aura of the Epoch
entries: Time crawls sluggishly in a 30-foot aura around Tanazir. Any enemy creature that starts its turn within the aura has its reaction suppressed and cannot use it until the start of its next turn. Additionally, if an enemy tries to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 reaction while within the aura, they must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or the spell fails and the slot is wasted.

trait.name: Cycle of Rebirth (Mythic Phase Trigger)
entries: When Tanazir is reduced to 0 hit points, his physical form doesn't die. Instead, his timeline instantly resets back to an optimized state: he sheds any ongoing conditions or hexes, teleports up to 60 feet away to an unoccupied space, and magically heals to 300 hit points. For the next 1 hour, his physical attacks deal an additional 11 ({@damage 2d10}) force damage on a hit. Once this trait activates, it cannot activate again for 7 days.

trait.name: Gnawbone's Scrying Echoes
entries: Inheriting Old Gnawbone's obsessive scrying arts fused with time magic, Tanazir perceives actions seconds before they unfold. Tanazir cannot be surprised. In addition, once per round when a creature Tanazir can see casts a spell, Tanazir automatically learns the spell's school and level before deciding whether to use his reaction to cast {@spell counterspell}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tanazir uses his Frightful Presence. He then makes three attacks: one with his Chrono-Poison Bite and two with his Claws.

action.name: Chrono-Poison Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d10 + 9}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) poison damage and 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its speed is halved until the start of Tanazir's next turn due to time-dilation.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 17} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of Tanazir's choice within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

action.name: Shadow Harvest {@recharge 5}
entries: Tanazir extends his dark tether into the shadows cast by creatures within 60 feet of him. Up to three creatures in that area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw or have their shadows ripped away to coalesce into physical form. An undead {@creature shadow} rises in an unoccupied space adjacent to each target that failed the saving throw. The summoned shadows roll initiative, take their turns on Tanazir's secondary turn, and obey his telepathic commands. Tanazir can have no more than six shadows under his control at a time. Alternatively, Tanazir can use this action to command any number of allied shadows within 60 feet of him to dissolve back into the ambient darkness: Tanazir regains 10 hit points for each shadow dissolved in this way.

action.name: Chronal Stasis
entries: Tanazir briefly steps completely outside the flow of time. This action functions exactly like the {@spell time stop} spell, giving Tanazir 2 ({@dice 1d3 + 1}) immediate, consecutive turns during which other creatures cannot move or act. If Tanazir leaves this state or affects another creature or an object worn or carried by them, the stasis ends immediately. Once Tanazir uses this action, he cannot use it again until the start of his next initiative turn.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: Tanazir uses one of the following breath weapons:

items: **Shadow-Poison Breath.** Tanazir exhales a 90-foot cone of decaying, toxic shadow. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Constitution saving throw, taking 84 ({@damage 24d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. A humanoid reduced to 0 hit points by this damage dies, and an undead {@creature shadow} rises from its corpse under Tanazir's permanent control.

**Time-Rift Breath.** Tanazir exhales a shimmering wave of chronal distortion in a 90-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 25} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 55 ({@damage 10d10}) force damage and is cast forward in time: it disappears, magically stepping out of the timeline until the end of Tanazir's next turn, effectively losing its placement in the initiative order and dropping {@status concentration} on any spells. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't displaced.

reaction.name: Temporal Slip
entries: When Tanazir is hit by an attack, he can cast his reaction out of time, briefly flickering out of existence. He rolls a {@dice d6}. On a 4 or higher, the attack misses him entirely, and he teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see.

legendary.name: Detect / Shadow Stealth
entries: Tanazir makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check or takes the Hide action if he is in dim light or darkness.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: Tanazir makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Gnaw the Fallen
entries: Tanazir targets one dead humanoid or allied {@creature shadow} within 10 feet of him and violently consumes it in his jaws. If the target is a shadow, it dissolves and Tanazir regains 15 hit points. If the target is a corpse, Tanazir mangles it, regains 25 hit points, and each enemy within 30 feet who witnesses the horrific display must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} until the end of its next turn.

legendary.name: Call to the Shadows (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tanazir commands an allied {@creature shadow} he can see within 90 feet to step into the shadow of a creature within 5 feet of it. The shadow vanishes into that creature's shadow and is destroyed, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or have its Strength score reduced by {@dice 1d4} and take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tanazir beats his wings. Each creature within 15 feet of him must succeed on a {@dc 25} Dexterity saving throw or take 16 ({@damage 2d6 + 9}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. Tanazir can then fly up to half his flying speed.

legendary.name: Mire of the Green (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Tanazir calls upon his green dragon domain to force grasping shadows and thorned vines to erupt from the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point he can see within 120 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature within must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained}.

legendary.name: Chronal Rewind (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Tanazir targets one creature he can see within 90 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or have its individual timeline rewound to the start of the round: it is teleported back to the physical space it occupied at the start of the round, any spell it cast since then is undone (expending the slot regardless), and any hit points it recovered are lost.
Tanazir rules from a fractured temporal hub deep within a twilight-choked primordial swamp where past, present, and future violently collide.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting (Psionics)
headerEntries: The ulitharid's innate spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 17}). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Creature Sense
entries: The ulitharid is aware of the presence of creatures within 2 miles of it that have an Intelligence score of 4 or higher. It knows the distance and direction to each creature, as well as each creature's Intelligence score, but can't sense anything else about it. A creature protected by a {@spell mind blank} spell, a {@spell nondetection} spell, or similar magic can't be perceived in this manner.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The ulitharid has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 4d10 + 5}) psychic damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}) and must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or be {@condition stunned} until this grapple ends.

action.name: Extract Brain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one {@condition incapacitated} humanoid {@condition grappled} by the ulitharid. {@h}55 ({@damage 10d10}) piercing damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points, the ulitharid kills the target by extracting and devouring its brain.

action.name: Mind Blast {@recharge 5}
entries: The ulitharid magically emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 17} Intelligence saving throw or take 31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) psychic damage and be {@condition stunned} for 1 minute. A target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Cleric Spellcasting
headerEntries: Wairi is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 21}, {@hit 13} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following cleric spells prepared:

trait.name: Avatar of Battle & Adamantine Protection
entries: Wairi has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks. Furthermore, any critical hit scored against Wairi becomes a normal hit.

trait.name: Boon of Fortitude
entries: Wairi's hit point maximum is increased by 40 (already included).

trait.name: Guaranteed Divine Intervention (1/Week)
entries: As an action, Wairi calls upon Torm to directly intervene. The request automatically succeeds without rolling percentile dice, duplicating the effect of any cleric spell or domain spell of 9th level or lower.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Wairi fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Supreme Healing
entries: Whenever Wairi casts a spell that restores hit points to a creature, he uses the highest possible number for each die rolled instead of rolling.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Wairi makes three weapon attacks with his Longbow +2 or the Staff of Healing, or he casts one spell and makes one weapon attack.

action.name: Longbow +2
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 10} to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage (from Divine Strike). Once per short rest, Wairi can grant himself a +20 bonus to this attack roll (Boon of Peerless Aim).

action.name: Staff of Healing
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) radiant damage.

action.name: Sunburst (8th-Level Spell; 1 Slot)
entries: Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a point up to 150 feet away. Each creature in that light must make a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, taking 42 ({@damage 12d6}) radiant damage and becoming {@condition blinded} for 1 minute on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Undead and oozes have disadvantage on this save.

action.name: Destroy Undead
entries: Wairi presents his holy symbol. Each undead within 30 feet that can see or hear him must make a {@dc 21} Wisdom saving throw. Undead of CR 4 or lower that fail are instantly destroyed; other failing undead are turned for 1 minute.

bonus.name: War Priest (6/Day)
entries: When Wairi takes the Attack action, he can make one additional weapon attack as a bonus action.

bonus.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
entries: Wairi activates one magic bead on his necklace as a bonus action to cast {@spell bless}, {@spell cure wounds} (2nd level), {@spell branding smite}, {@spell greater restoration}, {@spell planar ally}, or {@spell wind walk} without expending a spell slot.

reaction.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing (3/Day)
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of Wairi makes an attack roll, Wairi can grant that creature a +10 bonus to the roll after seeing the roll.

reaction.name: Blaze of Glory (1/Day)
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points by an attacker he can see, Wairi moves up to 30 feet toward the attacker and makes one melee attack with advantage, dealing an extra 27 ({@damage 5d10}) radiant damage and 27 ({@damage 5d10}) weapon damage on a hit before dropping to 0 HP.

legendary.name: Commanding Shot
entries: Wairi makes one Longbow +2 attack.

legendary.name: Divine Ward (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Wairi casts {@spell shield of faith} or {@spell sanctuary} on an ally within range without expending a spell slot.

legendary.name: Radiant Eruption (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Sacred light bursts in a 20-foot radius centered on Wairi. Enemies must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Allies in the area regain 20 hit points.

legendaryGroup.name: Chimeric Elder Brain
lairActions: The Chimeric Elder Brain dwells suspended over a massive vat of ceremorphosis brine, biologically warped with apex predator tissue.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the Chimeric Elder Brain takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; the brain can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: Fleshy tendrils sprout from the laboratory walls. Up to three creatures the brain can see within 60 feet must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} until initiative count 20 on the next round.

The purple ceremorphosis fluid in the pool surges with static. Each creature standing in or within 10 feet of the brine pool must make a {@dc 18} Intelligence saving throw, taking 18 ({@damage 4d8}) psychic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.

regionalEffects: The region containing the Chimeric Elder Brain's lair is warped by mutated thoughts and psychic resonance, creating one or more of the following effects:

items: Beasts within 5 miles of the lair display eerie, humanlike intelligence and territorial aggression, grouping into uncharacteristic hunting packs.
Humanoids traveling within 1 mile of the lair experience vivid, waking hallucinations of flesh grafting and echoes of primal animal screams.

regionalEffects: If the Chimeric Elder Brain dies, these effects fade over the course of {@dice 1d10} days.

legendaryGroup.name: Renwick the Ascendant
lairActions: Renwick's personal sanctum—whether nested within the ancient passages beneath Summit Hall or suspended aboard a rebuilt shard of Baator's floating citadel—is warded by shifting infernal geometries, tournament cinder conduits, and ancient Misque glyph arrays.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Renwick takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; Renwick can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: Renwick commands the citadel's shifting geometries. Up to three 10-foot cubes of solid stone or iron within 120 feet of him rearrange, phase out, or seal shut, opening new pathways or sealing existing corridors. Any creature caught inside a newly formed barrier must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw; on a failed save, it takes 22 ({@damage 4d10}) force damage and is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, or half damage and safely moved on a success.

Renwick triggers a primary floor rune of Misque at a point he can see within 90 feet. A 20-foot-radius glowing glyph flares on the ground until initiative count 20 on the next round. While in the area, hostile creatures cannot cast spells of 3rd level or lower, and any creature attempting to cast a spell of 4th level or higher must succeed on a {@dc 21} Intelligence saving throw or the spell slot is consumed with no effect.

Searing flames vent from floor grates and planar conduit seams across the lair. Magma and hellfire erupt in two 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinders centered on points Renwick chooses within 120 feet. Each creature in those areas must make a {@dc 21} Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) fire damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area ignite.

regionalEffects: The region containing Renwick's sanctum or floating citadel is warped by his planar research and arcane wards, creating the following effects:

items: Divination spells of 7th level or lower cast by creatures outside the lair cannot penetrate within 3 miles of the sanctum, and magical scrying sensors fail to manifest within this boundary. The citadel and its grounds are completely invisible to aerial observers flying more than 500 feet above it.

Inscribed stones, ancient archways, and structural ruins within 1 mile of the lair pulse with faint violet light whenever magical spells are cast nearby. Non-evil spellcasters who complete a short or long rest in this area find their spell foci humming with static, granting them a +1 bonus to their next spell save DC within 24 hours.

Air within 1 mile of the lair is dry and carries the faint smell of brimstone, embers, and heated iron. Water sources evaporate twice as fast, and small illusions of swirling embers drift harmlessly through dark corridors.

regionalEffects: If Renwick is destroyed, the regional effects fade over the course of {@dice 1d10} days.

legendaryGroup.name: Tanazir Silverquil
lairActions: Tanazir rules from a fractured temporal hub deep within a twilight-choked primordial swamp where past, present, and future violently collide.
On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), Tanazir takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; Tanazir can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

items: **Chronal Echoes.** Tanazir manipulates the timestream of the lair, forcing the echoes of past and future moments to collide. Up to three creatures Tanazir can see within 120 feet must succeed on a {@dc 22} Wisdom saving throw or be affected by a temporal duplicate. Until initiative count 20 on the next round, whenever an affected target takes an action, moves, or casts a spell, it must immediately roll a {@dice d6}. On a 1–3, the action or movement is delayed and fails to resolve until the very end of the current turn.

**Umbral Fog.** A cloud of thick, caustic, shadow-infused green gas fills a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Tanazir can see within 120 feet. The fog spreads around corners, and its area is heavily obscured. Each creature that starts its turn in the fog or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a {@dc 22} Constitution saving throw, taking 28 ({@damage 8d6}) poison damage and 14 ({@damage 4d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. The fog lasts until initiative count 20 on the next round.

**Grasping Timelines.** Tendrils of dark, vine-like shadows erupt from the floor, walls, and ceiling in a 40-foot radius centered on a point Tanazir chooses within 90 feet. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 22} Strength saving throw or be {@condition restrained} by the paradoxical timeline fragments. A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 22} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics}) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The vines disappear on initiative count 20 of the next round.

regionalEffects: The region containing Tanazir Silverquil's lair is warped by his multifaceted draconic magic, which creates one or more of the following effects:

items: **Thickened Wilderness & Umbral Overgrowth.** Within 6 miles of the lair, forests and vegetation mutate rapidly, growing thick with thorned vines and leaves that actively absorb light. The area is permanently treated as dim light, even during a clear midday. Furthermore, any check made to track a creature or navigate through this region has disadvantage due to the shifting undergrowth.

**Chronal Fractures.** Within 6 miles of the lair, local time becomes unstable. Time passes differently for travelers: a group might spend what feels like 1 hour traversing a forest path, only to discover that 24 hours have passed in the outside world. Clocks, sundials, and magical time-tracking items spin wildly or freeze completely.

**Caustic Fog & Whispering Shadows.** Within 1 mile of the lair, a light, toxic green mist blankets the ground. Beasts native to the area become aggressive and corrupted, possessing glowing emerald eyes and shadows that seem detached from their physical bodies. Creatures resting within this area hear faint, overlapping echoes of their own past and future conversations whispering from the fog.

regionalEffects: If Tanazir Silverquil dies, these effects fade over the course of {@dice 1d10} days.
